title: Give the test launcher a supported way to stop a detached gate whose input is already superseded
outcome: Give the test launcher a supported way to stop a detached gate whose input is already superseded
acceptance: On Windows, `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs stop RUN_ID --reason TEXT --actor TEXT` supports stopping a new detached full gate with owned Job Object containment. After cleanup it records a nonpassing terminal result using the existing failed/interrupted classification, reason stopped and retained stop actor/reason; POSIX and unsupported legacy runs refuse unchanged.

A supported stopped run releases its contained process tree, including cargo/rustc descendants, before terminal publication and reports interruption through the existing completion notification path, never as a pass.

Tests cover stopping during compile, ordinary rust and scale stages, detached descendants and parent-exit cleanup, retained concurrent requests and completion races, completed-run no-op with a clear message, and refusal for a nonexistent or unsupported run id.

completion.summary: Shipped supported Windows detached-gate stop with owned Job Object cleanup before nonpassing interrupted terminal/notification publication; lifecycle and containment regression coverage delivered in Batch AB.
